resolution.plan: The MultiWOZ tool-agent environment (helper APIs, the 89 selected test scenarios, 30-step limit), the GPT-4.1-mini collaborative user simulator (Appendix G listings) and the GPT-4o-mini goal-completion judge are all in the repository. Run gpt-4.1-nano as the ReAct agent for 4 trials over 89 scenarios and report the success rate (23.6).
